IRGC says a second supertanker hit a naval mine in Hormuz and declares the strait closed
Houthis claim strikes on Saudi Shaybah oilfield, Aramco Yanbu site and Riyadh and Abha airports
events.summary: Yemen's Houthis said they attacked Saudi energy, airport and military targets including the Shaybah oilfield, an Aramco site in Yanbu, King Khalid airport in Riyadh and Abha airport; Saudi damage was not confirmed in the report.

events.title: IRGC says a second supertanker hit a naval mine in Hormuz and declares the strait closed
events.summary: Iran's IRGC said a second supertanker struck a naval mine on an unauthorized Strait of Hormuz route and declared the strait closed after the tanker hits; the vessels were not identified and the US says the strait is under US and partner control. The claims are unverified.

events.title: NBC: attacks on ships around the Strait of Hormuz reach record highs as Iran steps up strikes
events.summary: NBC News reported attacks on vessels around Hormuz have reached record levels with little US response; Reuters-cited tracking had already counted at least 12 tanker attacks in the week to Oct 5, the most since the war began.

events.title: UKMTO: tanker hit by unidentified projectile northeast of Saudi Arabia's Jubail
events.summary: UKMTO reported a tanker was struck by an unidentified projectile northeast of Jubail on Friday; the crew was safe and evacuated. It extends Gulf shipping attacks beyond the Strait of Hormuz into Saudi waters.

events.title: IRGC says a supertanker caught fire after hitting a naval mine on an 'unauthorized' Hormuz route
events.summary: Iran's Revolutionary Guards said an oil tanker ignited after striking a naval mine while using what they called an unauthorized route through the Strait of Hormuz; the vessel was not identified and the claim was not independently verified. It follows similar IRGC claims on Oct 10 (supertanker) and Oct 14 (container ship).

events.title: IRGC says it can extend the blockade to Bab al-Mandeb and Suez, warns on Hormuz undersea cables
events.summary: An IRGC spokesman said Tehran has not fully closed the Strait of Hormuz and can expand the blockade to the Bab al-Mandeb Strait and Suez Canal, and separately pointed to seven major data cables under Hormuz.

events.title: Indian official says crude tanker targeted by missile in Strait of Hormuz
events.summary: An Indian shipping official said a crude oil tanker was targeted by a missile in the Strait of Hormuz on Friday and also referred to the recent Romania-linked tanker incident; it adds to this week's string of attacks on Gulf shipping.

events.title: Iran deploys new tactics against ships; two vessels struck in Strait of Hormuz
events.summary: Brent rose to about $106.32 early on 14 Oct after two vessels were hit. Kpler: only 2.9m barrels moved through Hormuz on 11 Oct vs 17.1m b/d pre-war.

events.title: Houthi attack on Yemeni government camp in Shabwa kills at least 18
events.summary: Reuters sources say at least 18 were killed when the Houthis struck a Yemeni government military camp in Shabwa, as the Yemen war re-erupts.

events.title: Houthi missile hits Saudi Aramco headquarters in Dhahran; Houthis vow more attacks on Saudi oil sites
events.summary: A Houthi ballistic missile struck an office tower at Aramco's Dhahran complex late on 13 October, causing a fire; Saudi officials said there were no injuries and operations continued. Brent settled near $106 on 14 October and the Houthis vowed further strikes on Saudi oil facilities and airports.

events.title: IRGC navy says another oil tanker exploded after hitting a mine in the Strait of Hormuz
events.summary: Iranian media cited the IRGC navy saying an oil tanker caught fire and blasted after striking a mine in the Strait of Hormuz; no vessel name or independent confirmation was given.

events.title: Saudi civil defence says six injured after a projectile lands in Najran
events.summary: Saudi civil defence said six people were injured when a projectile landed in Najran near the Yemen border, as GCC states condemned Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia.

events.title: UKMTO: tug hit by two unidentified projectiles northeast of Khor Fakkan, UAE
events.summary: UKMTO said a southbound tug reported being hit by two unidentified projectiles northeast of Khor Fakkan, UAE; the tug was damaged but continued on its course.

events.title: Saudi-led coalition intercepts two Houthi ballistic missiles fired toward Khamis Mushait and a drone over Riyadh
events.summary: The Saudi-led coalition said it intercepted and destroyed two Houthi ballistic missiles launched toward Khamis Mushait, and later a drone in the Riyadh region, after civil defence alerts for Abha and Khamis Mushait earlier on Saturday.

events.title: CENTCOM says the 'vast majority' of Iran's attempted attacks in the Strait of Hormuz are unsuccessful
events.summary: A US Central Command spokesman said most of Iran's attempted attacks on shipping in the Strait of Hormuz have failed, after the IRGC claimed two supertankers hit mines and declared the strait closed. Headline-based; search did not surface the statement.

events.title: UKMTO: skiff fires shots at LNG tanker 140 nm southeast of Mukalla, Yemen
events.summary: UKMTO reported an LNG tanker approached by a small skiff with seven people on board about 140 nautical miles southeast of Al Mukalla on 17 October; the skiff fired two shots and the ship's armed guards fired two warning shots, forcing it away (FinancialJuice). No damage was reported in the headlines.

events.title: US to let dark-fleet tankers shed sanctions, Energy Secretary Wright says
events.summary: Energy Secretary Chris Wright said the US will allow sanctioned 'dark fleet' tankers to shed sanctions, adding that dozens to hundreds of vessels could be converted, as record tanker rates hurt US crude demand.

events.title: Report says Iran is giving Houthis target intelligence for strikes on Saudi Arabia
events.summary: The Jerusalem Post, citing a report, said Iran is supplying Yemen's Houthis with targeting intelligence for drone and missile strikes on Saudi Arabia, after Houthi missiles hit Aden airport this week.

events.title: Strait of Hormuz scoured for spilt cargo after Iran attacks container ships
events.summary: The Guardian reported searches for lost cargo after attacks on container ships in Hormuz; Singapore-flagged feeder GFS Pride sank with its containers aboard and all 21 crew evacuated.

events.title: Saudi-led coalition says it destroyed two ballistic missile launchers in Yemen's Saada
events.summary: The Saudi-led coalition said it destroyed two Houthi ballistic missile launchers in Saada, hours after the Houthis fired two missiles at Aden airport and Saudi civil defence warned of a threat in Abha and Khamis Mushait (later lifted).
